nexus.helpCategory: Groups your publication into a major field of knowledge (e.g. Science, Health, Technology), directing it to the right audience.

nexus.helpType: Defines methodological rigor and content nature (e.g. Scientific Article with sources, Personal Experience, or Technical Analysis).
nexus.helpTitle: The main headline of your article. Should be direct, rigorous, and truthful without misleading clickbait.
nexus.helpMarkdown: Full body of your article with rich Markdown formatting (#, **, lists, tables, and code). Required before adding attachments.
nexus.helpAttachments: Complementary resources like cover images, video files, or repository links to enrich your publication.
nexus.helpImage: Direct HTTPS URL for the cover image displayed on article header and feed cards.
nexus.helpVideo: Demonstration or explanatory video file (MP4 or WebM up to 100 MiB) embedded into the article.
nexus.helpUrl: Trusted external reference link (academic repository, GitHub, full paper, or official documentation).
nexus.helpMentions: Credit or cite collaborators, researchers, or notable figures mentioned in the text.
nexus.helpMinAge: Recommended age rating (All ages, 13+, 16+, or 18+) for topics that may require greater maturity.
nexus.helpTags: Comma-separated keywords helping discovery in search and feed recommendations.
nexus.helpSources: Formal bibliographic record. Required for scientific articles to receive the verified badge.
nexus.helpSourceTitle: Official title of the cited study, book, paper, or report.
nexus.helpSourceAuthors: Names of authors, researchers, or institutions responsible for the cited work.
nexus.helpSourceYear: Original year of publication of the cited source.
nexus.helpSourceDoi: DOI identifier (e.g. 10.1038/...) or academic URL for immediate source verification.
